// Chokepoint fixture (mcp-stdout-graph, PLUG-13): stands in for bin/cli/plan.ts,
// the verb the MCP tool pensmith_plan imports (mcp/tools.ts → bin/cli/plan.ts).
// It prints its result line straight to the process's stdout, as plan.ts did
// before the output sink — directly, through globalThis.console, through
// the stream taken out of process under another name, through console.count /
// group, and through process taken under another name: under the MCP server
// each line lands in the JSON-RPC stream. The harness walks the real mcp/
// modules, reaches this text at bin/cli/plan.ts, and must report the chain.
import { defineCommand } from 'citty';
import { stdout } from 'node:process';

export const planCommand = defineCommand({
  meta: { name: 'plan', description: 'Plan one section.' },
  args: { n: { type: 'positional', required: true } },
  async run({ args }) {
    process.stdout.write(`pensmith plan: wrote PLAN.md for section ${String(args.n)}\n`);
    globalThis.console.log('pensmith plan: done');
    stdout.write('pensmith plan: imported stream\n');
    const { stdout: s } = process;
    s.write('pensmith plan: destructured stream\n');
    console.count('pensmith');
    console.group('pensmith plan: wrote PLAN.md');
    const p = process;
    p.stdout.write('pensmith plan: aliased process\n');
    return { ok: true };
  },
});

export default planCommand;
